title: Smoky Chicken Skillet
description: A flavorful and spicy chicken skillet recipe perfect for any meal.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with smoky kissed chicken seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and sear for 5-6 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
If using american cheese, sprinkle it over the top of the chicken during the last 2-3 minutes of baking.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
